hooks.command: input=$(cat); subagent=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.subagent_type // ""'); if [ "$subagent" = "marketing-director" ]; then echo "[marketing-sync] firing"; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npm run sync:marketing 2>&1 | tail -5 || true; elif [ "$subagent" = "operations-director" ]; then echo "[operations-sync] firing"; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npm run sync:operations 2>&1 | tail -5 || true; fi

input=$(cat); file=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$file" in *prisma/schema.prisma) if [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/.allow-schema-edit" ]; then rm "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/.allow-schema-edit"; echo '[BYPASS] one-shot schema edit allowed (sentinel consumed)' >&2; exit 0; fi; echo '[BLOCK] prisma/schema.prisma is protected (memory: prisma_schema_drift.md — deleted cost columns still hold prod data; use raw SQL CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS instead). To allow one edit: touch .claude/.allow-schema-edit' >&2; exit 2 ;; *.env.local|*.env.production|*.env|*.env.*) if [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/.allow-env-edit" ]; then rm "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/.allow-env-edit"; echo '[BYPASS] one-shot env edit allowed (sentinel consumed)' >&2; exit 0; fi; echo '[BLOCK] env files contain live secrets (Stripe, QB, Plaid, Resend). To allow one edit: touch .claude/.allow-env-edit' >&2; exit 2 ;; esac

input=$(cat); file=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$file" in ''|*$'\n'*|*$'\r'*|*\;*|*\&*|*\|*|*\`*|*\$*|*\(*|*\)*|*\<*|*\>*|*' '*) exit 0 ;; esac; case "$file" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.mjs|*.cjs) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npx eslint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern -- "$file" 2>&1 | tail -30 ;; esac
